requirements.figureRule: All new SVG must be created by official SVG engine; original similar role parity should be respected.
requirements.firstGate: Replace all 116 generic solution texts with verified full mathematics and fix metadata; do not publish content before that.
requirements.secondGate: Author/source conditional figures without solved numbers; adjust and lint six JSON drafts, then engine render and actual PNG visual QA.
requirements.thirdGate: Create 53 solution figure packets only after corresponding solution is corrected; no fake EXEMPT based on missing explanation.

sample line y=-x-4 and four exact points encode one solution branch; problem-role publication must suppress derived numbers/line formula.
prototype f=-x²+6x derives solved parameter; use purely schematic curve or suppress exposed coefficients in final problem image.

source has symbolic h and a; coordinate realization uses arbitrary ratio. Engine h/a symbolic textLabels supported 여부 및 삼각형 접촉 검수.
